blocks.content: Petrology is the science of rocks.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Earth's crust is composed of various types of rocks, which are naturally occurring solid aggregates of one or more minerals.
Petrology is the branch of geology dedicated to the scientific study of rocks, including their composition, texture, and origin.
Feldspar and quartz are among the most abundant silicate minerals constituting the Earth's crustal rocks.
Based on their mode of formation, rocks are classified into three fundamental categories: Igneous, Sedimentary, and Metamorphic.

rows: Cooling and solidification of molten magma or lava
Deposition, compaction, and lithification of rock fragments and organic matter
Recrystallization and reorganization of pre-existing rocks under high heat and pressure

items: Oxygen (46.6%) and Silicon (27.7%) are the two most abundant chemical elements in the Earth's crust.
Igneous rocks are termed Primary Rocks because all other rock types are ultimately derived from them.
Competitive exams frequently test the distinction between Petrology (study of rocks) and Mineralogy (study of minerals).
